title: lint(searchable-fields): report a `searchableFields` entry that names a `secret` or `password` field, which the engine now drops without a word (follow-up to #27477)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** The maintainer, in the PM session `session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk` on 2026-10-29, said (verbatim): 「其他任务正常提交 issue」. This card is a non-security follow-up to PR #27477 (merged), filed as a normal card.

Business reason: since #27477 the engine leaves every `secret` / `password` column out of the set `search` scans, including one an author names in the object's own `searchableFields`. That is the right runtime answer, but it is silent: `os validate` and the object publish door pass the declaration, and the author's searchable set is quietly narrower than written (and, when every entry is a credential field, quietly becomes the auto-default set). A build-time finding tells the author at the moment they write it, which is the same posture the linter already takes for a `formula` entry (#6674).
Reader: the dev who takes this card from the queue (the `packages/lint` search-fields rule, with a pin test beside it).
Dedupe: searched the open and closed issues (GitHub issue search scoped to `objectstack-ai/objectstack`) for "searchableFields secret password credential field warning" (7 hits) and "lint searchable-field-unsearchable secret password type in object searchableFields dropped silently" (27 hits). The nearest is #27660 (open), which teaches the rule in `skills/objectstack-data`; it is a docs card and owns no lint or runtime change. No card covers this one.

## What to change

Where the entry is dropped (read at `origin/main` `a75ddba1`):
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:13405–13419` (`expandSearchOnAst`): the field map handed to the search expansion is built without every name `collectCredentialFields(schema)` returns (`packages/objectql/src/secret-fields.ts:289`, type `secret` or `password`), while `searchableFields` is passed through as declared.
- `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts:246` (`resolveSearchFieldResolution`): the declared branch keeps only entries present in that field map, so a credential entry is filtered out by the existence check. When every declared entry is filtered out, the function falls back to the auto-default set (the degenerate case documented at `:236`).
- Nothing reports it. `packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts` checks the object's own set for existence and, since #6674, for virtual (`formula`) entries (`:63–70`, the check at `:414`). It has no credential-type check, so a `secret` / `password` entry passes both.

The ask:
1. In `packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.ts`, next to the virtual-entry check at `:414`, report a `searchableFields` entry whose field type is `secret` or `password`, on every surface that check covers (the object's own set, list views, and a react page's `<ListView searchableFields>`). The remedy line: drop the entry, credential fields are never searched. Reuse a shared predicate for "is this a credential type" rather than a second type literal, as the virtual check reuses `isVirtualSearchField`.
2. Choose the severity deliberately (error, as the virtual entry is, or warning) and say why in the rule's doc comment and its `os explain` entry.
3. Pin it in `packages/lint/src/validate-searchable-fields.test.ts`: one case each for `secret` and `password` on the object's own set and on a list view, plus a control (a text field in the same list passes).

Related: #27660 (the skill half of the same rule).

Out of scope: any runtime change. The engine's handling in `expandSearchOnAst` stays as it is.
